line: Tell someone the story of how they once helped you.
paragraph: Jonathan Thai ran triathlons as a teenager in Georgia. When the local REI closed its community bike-riding workshop, he saw a gap and decided to fill it. He started the Pedal Forward Foundation and raised more than thirty thousand dollars. Hundreds of low-income children received bicycles. Hundreds more learned how to ride them. Someone who watched a wobbly first ride become a steady pedal home might tell him that story years later.
